blurb: Guests join small group tours of up to 12 passengers on open 26 ft Zodiac boats to see wildlife such as grey whales, humpback whales, orcas, black bears, sea otters, sea lions, seals, and bald eagles. Tours include whale watching in Clayoquot Sound, bear watching along rocky beaches, and a hot springs tour with a scenic boat ride and rainforest walk. All passengers are provided with full-body Mustang Survival Suits and additional cold weather gear as needed for comfort and safety.
